about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A38: more Asian rice plates and tiffin, cold platters, pasta and kid-friendly lunches.

recipes.title: Gyeran Mari (Korean Rolled Omelette Lunch Plate)
recipes.summary: Fluffy vegetable-flecked rolled omelette with rice, kimchi and spinach, a classic Korean banchan lunch.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the carrot, spring onions, soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
Oil a small non-stick pan over low-medium heat and pour in a thin layer of egg.
When just set but still glossy, roll it to one side, add more egg and roll again, repeating until the egg is used up and the omelette is set.
Wilt the spinach in a splash of water until soft, about 1 minute, and squeeze dry.
Slice the omelette and plate with the rice, kimchi and spinach.
notes: Contains egg and soy; kimchi often contains fish sauce.

Food safety: cook the omelette until the egg is completely set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

recipes.title: Khao Kha Moo (Thai Braised Pork on Rice)
recipes.summary: Tender five-spice braised pork with a boiled egg over rice, with pickled mustard greens.

items: 700g pork shoulder, cut into large chunks

steps: Combine the pork, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, pepper, star anise, five-spice and water in a pot.
Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently until the pork is very tender, about 90 minutes.
Add the eggs for the last 10 minutes until they take on colour.
Serve the sliced pork and eggs on the rice with the sauce and pickle.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C and be cooked until tender; cool leftovers quickly and eat within 2 days.
Contains egg and soy.

recipes.title: Tomato Rice Tiffin (Thakkali Sadam)
recipes.summary: Tangy South Indian tomato rice with onion, ginger and spices, packed with yoghurt for the tiffin.
steps: Heat the oil and pop the mustard seeds, then fry the onion until soft and golden, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger, curry leaf and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and cook until jammy, about 8 minutes.
Fold through the rice and salt until evenly coloured.
Pack with the yoghurt in the tiffin.
notes: Food safety: cool the rice quickly, refrigerate within 1 hour and eat within 4 hours out of the fridge.
Contains milk and mustard.

recipes.title: Aloo Paratha with Yoghurt and Pickle
recipes.summary: Soft whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato, served with yoghurt and mango pickle.
steps: Knead the flour, water, oil and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and rest it for 20 minutes.
Mix the potato, chilli, cumin, garam masala, coriander and salt.
Roll the dough into 8 small rounds, put a spoon of filling in the middle of half of them, cover with the rest and seal the edges.
Roll each gently flat, then cook in a dry hot pan until brown spots appear on both sides, about 2 minutes a side, brushing with butter.
Serve hot with yoghurt and pickle.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Antipasto Lunch Platter with Marinated Vegetables
recipes.summary: Cured meats, mozzarella, olives and marinated vegetables with crusty bread, a no-cook summer lunch.
steps: Tear the mozzarella and arrange it on a board with the prosciutto and salami.
Toss the capsicum, tomatoes and olives with the oil and vinegar until well coated.
Add the vegetables and rocket to the board.
Slice the baguette and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cured meats and cheese should stay below 5°C and be eaten within 2 hours at room temperature; pregnant people are often advised to avoid cured meats.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Cold Poached Chicken Platter with Green Herb Sauce
recipes.summary: Sliced poached chicken with potatoes, green beans and a punchy parsley and caper sauce.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water with the bay leaf until cooked through and the juices run clear, about 16 minutes, then chill.
Boil the potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Stir the parsley, capers, garlic, oil, lemon juice and mustard into a sauce.
Slice the chicken and arrange with the potatoes and beans and spoon the sauce over.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C; chill quickly and keep below 5°C, serving within 2 hours at room temperature.
Contains mustard.

recipes.title: Summer Rice Paper Platter with Prawns and Herbs
recipes.summary: Build-your-own rice paper rolls with prawns, vermicelli, herbs and a peanut dipping sauce.
steps: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water until tender, about 4 minutes, rinse cold and drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and 3 tbsp warm water into a dipping sauce.
Arrange the prawns, noodles, vegetables, herbs and lettuce on a platter.
Dip each rice paper in warm water until just soft, fill, fold in the sides, roll up tightly and serve with the sauce.
notes: Food safety: keep cooked prawns below 5°C and eat within 2 days.
Contains shellfish, peanuts and soy.

recipes.title: Mini Pizza Pitas for Kids
recipes.summary: Little pizzas on pita bread with tomato, ham, pineapple and melting cheese, ready in 12 minutes.
steps: Spread each pita with passata.
Top with ham, pineapple and mozzarella.
Bake at 220°C until the cheese is melted and bubbling, about 8 minutes.
Cool for a few minutes and slice into wedges.
notes: Food safety: serve hot throughout and let cool before giving to small children.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice for Kids with Peas and Corn
recipes.summary: Mild fried rice with scrambled egg, peas, corn and a touch of soy, quick and lunchbox friendly.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the carrot for 2 minutes until just soft.
Push aside, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until set.
Add the cold rice, peas and corn and stir-fry for 3 minutes until piping hot.
Stir through the soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: use rice cooled quickly and refrigerated within 1 hour of cooking, and eat the dish the same day.
Contains egg and soy.

recipes.title: Chicken and Vegetable Quesadilla Triangles for Kids
recipes.summary: Crisp tortillas filled with shredded chicken, grated zucchini and melted cheese, cut into easy triangles.
steps: Squeeze the water from the zucchini and mix with the chicken, cheese and cumin.
Spread the filling over 3 tortillas and top with the rest.
Cook each quesadilla in a lightly oiled pan until golden and the cheese melts, about 3 minutes a side.
Rest for 2 minutes and cut into triangles.
notes: Food safety: use chicken cooked to 75°C and chilled promptly; the quesadilla must be piping hot inside.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Tuna and Sweetcorn Rice Balls for Lunchboxes
recipes.summary: Soft rice balls with tuna mayo and sweetcorn wrapped in a strip of nori, easy to eat with small hands.
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, corn and soy sauce.
Wet your hands, take a handful of rice and press a hollow in the middle until it is a firm cup shape.
Add a spoon of filling, close the rice around it and shape into a ball or triangle.
Wrap a strip of nori around each ball.
notes: Food safety: use rice cooled quickly after cooking; keep the rice balls below 5°C and eat within 4 hours.
Contains fish, egg and soy.
